---
title: "Risk rating (Output 5)"
guide-section: "User Guide"
---

Output 5 combines baseline and stress paths with the CI thresholds, then adds
moderate-risk headroom and market-financing signals. Edit CI Summary, Input 1,
Input 6/7, Macro, and Ext in Excel before computing it.

> Excel → baseline + stresses + CI/market inputs → Output 5-1 / 5-2

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.run import SHEET_5_1, SHEET_5_2, compute_outputs

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
output = compute_outputs(workbook, include=[SHEET_5_1, SHEET_5_2])

moderate = output.sheets[SHEET_5_1]
market = output.sheets[SHEET_5_2]
```

Output 5-1 reports moderate-risk space from the mechanical external rating and
PV-of-debt headroom. Output 5-2 assesses market financing from market access,
the EMBI spread, and near-term public gross financing needs.

## How Chart Data becomes a rating

`ChartDataRegistry` collects the five threshold indicators:

- four external baseline and stress paths;
- the public PV-of-debt-to-GDP baseline and stress path.

`compute_mechanical_ratings` evaluates those paths against the thresholds
loaded from CI Summary. `moderate_panel` and `market_panel` then build the two
Output 5 panels. The paired notebook shows this expanded wiring when you need
to register or inspect scenarios yourself.

## Excel cues

| Concept | Template |
|---------|----------|
| CI score, capacity, thresholds | CI Summary |
| Baseline and stressed breaches | Chart Data |
| Moderate-risk headroom | Output 5-1 |
| Market access, EMBI, near-term GFN | Input 1 → Output 5-2 |

Output 5 is mechanical. Judgement and the combined rating summary are handled
on [Output 7](07-risk-summary.qmd).

The complete worked example is
[`demo/output_5.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/output_5.ipynb).
